'''Kaon Sentinel Mk. III''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by the [[Kaon City]] security forces on [[Kaon]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak]] on Kaon in [[3639 BBY]], many Mk. III Sentinels were deployed to contain the [[Rakghoul]]s.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaon Sentinel Mk. III droids appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Kaon Under Siege" flashpoint.
